svg.title: RubricMiddleware on the 25 tasks that Qwen3 8B failed as a plain loop
svg.desc: One row for each of the 25 tasks that a plain loop of Qwen3 8B failed, rerun with create_agent and RubricMiddleware with Qwen3 14B as the grader. Squares give each grader verdict in order. 14 runs ended with the verdict satisfied and 12 of those still failed the state checker. 11 runs reached the limit of three rounds. 3 tasks passed: r06, sql03, sql09.
svg.text: 14 runs ended satisfied and 12 of them failed the check. 3 of 25 tasks passed.
Worker calls 108 to 173, plus 56 grader calls.
